  "title": "Neon Torus Wireframe",
  "code": "let angleX = 0;\nlet angleY = 0;\n\nfunction setup() {\n  createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);\n}\n\nfunction draw() {\n  background(params.bgColor);\n  \n  angleX += 0.01 * params.speed;\n  angleY += 0.015 * params.speed;\n  \n  rotateX(angleX);\n  rotateY(angleY);\n  \n  stroke(params.neonColor);\n  strokeWeight(params.strokeWidth);\n  noFill();\n  \n  let r = params.radius;\n  let tubeR = params.tubeRadius;\n  let detail = params.detail;\n  \n  beginShape(POINTS);\n  for (let i = 0; i < detail; i++) {\n    let u = (i / detail) * TWO_PI;\n    for (let j = 0; j < detail; j++) {\n      let v = (j / detail) * TWO_PI;\n      let x = (r + tubeR * cos(v)) * cos(u);\n      let y = (r + tubeR * cos(v)) * sin(u);\n      let z = tubeR * sin(v);\n      vertex(x, y, z);\n    }\n  }\n  endShape();\n  \n  push();\n  rotateZ(frameCount * 0.02 * params.speed);\n  stroke(params.innerColor);\n  strokeWeight(params.strokeWidth * 0.5);\n  torus(r * 0.5, tubeR * 0.3, detail / 2, detail / 2);\n  pop();\n}\n\nfunction windowResized() {\n  resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);\n}",

{
  "title": "Lorenz Attractor",
  "code": "let x = 0.1;\nlet y = 0;\nlet z = 0;\nlet sigma = 10;\nlet rho = 28;\nlet beta = 8.0 / 3.0;\nlet points = [];\n\nfunction setup() {\n  createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);\n  colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100, 100);\n  x = 0.1;\n  y = 0.0;\n  z = 0.0;\n  points = [];\n}\n\nfunction draw() {\n  background(params.bgColor);\n\n  let dt = 0.01 * params.speed;\n  for (let i = 0; i < floor(params.detail); i++) {\n    let dx = (sigma * (y - x)) * dt;\n    let dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt;\n    let dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt;\n    x += dx;\n    y += dy;\n    z += dz;\n    points.push(createVector(x, y, z));\n    if (points.length > 2500) {\n      points.shift();\n    }\n  }\n\n  rotateX(frameCount * 0.005 * params.rotSpeed);\n  rotateY(frameCount * 0.007 * params.rotSpeed);\n  rotateZ(frameCount * 0.003 * params.rotSpeed);\n\n  scale(params.zoom);\n  translate(0, 0, -25);\n\n  noFill();\n  beginShape();\n  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {\n    let v = points[i];\n    let hu = (i * 0.2 + frameCount * params.colorSpeed) % 360;\n    stroke(hu, 80, 90, 80);\n    strokeWeight(params.weight);\n    vertex(v.x, v.y, v.z);\n  }\n  endShape();\n}\n\nfunction windowResized() {\n  resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);\n}",
